_comment: Scenarios: a world with a goal (`ConfigLoader.load_scenario_bundle`, `ScenarioRunner`). `selection` picks setup options as the setup screen does (the style stays the player's); `patch` is merged over the bundle after them; `challenge` goes into the bundle as it is and is what the runner keeps score by; its `result` holds the result window's titles. `own_herd.near` is a point in fractions of the map: the herd of `own_herd.species` nearest it at the start is the player's. A goal names what must hold - `share_at_least`, the own herd against its size at the start, `thirst_deaths_at_most`, its deaths of thirst, or `thirst_share_at_most`, those as a share of its size at the start - and when: `form` `at_season_start` on the first tick of `season` (or `days` into it), `always` on every tick. Its `role` says what it decides: `win`, won if it holds at its moment and lost if not; `lose`, lost the moment it stops holding; `bonus`, nothing - it is kept or not.

long_drought.label: Долгая сушь
long_drought.brief: Засушливое лето: пруды с первого дня наполовину пусты, к концу лета пересохнут почти все, а дожди наполнят их только посреди осени. Сохраните хотя бы половину своего стада оленей до осенних дождей. Один раз можно выкопать водопой и дважды — повести стадо к воде.

goals.label: Сохранить половину стада до осенних дождей
